spec.overview: A single-process CLI dashboard (React + Ink) that monitors AI agent instances running in tmux, sends messages to them, and provides lightweight session management. Runs on a second monitor as a "mission control" for parallel agent workflows.

principle.title: gmux never kills what it doesn't own
principle.description: An unexpected gmux crash or quit leaves all tmux sessions untouched. gmux only manages its own process lifecycle (socket, pid file).

principle.title: Graceful degradation
principle.description: Socket failure degrades to polling-only mode. tmux unreachable degrades to stale data with warning banner. Notification failure degrades to dashboard-only. gmux never crashes due to external system failure.

principle.title: Phase 1 scope: Claude Code only
principle.description: Agent detection targets Claude Code via version-pattern matching. Architecture supports adding Codex CLI, Gemini CLI in future phases without restructuring.
